summary: ```markdown # CLO 2025.0 - Virtual Model In this video, I will introduce the functions of the virtual model for you. ## Introduction to Virtual Model Adjustments In the 2025 version, we can use the slide to easily adjust the shape of the male and female virtual models. To demonstrate this function, we add a female virtual model of FV2.1 and open the virtual model editor. ### Adjustable Parameters for Hip Shape In the shape of the virtual model size, you will see a new hip part, which includes two adjustable parameters: waistline and size. In the default situation, both are set to 50%. You can create various hip shapes by changing these values. The way the slide is operated is the same as the operation of adjusting the chest shape. It can be easily controlled by dragging the slide. You can also make more accurate adjustments by inputting values directly on the right side. If you want to reset all the changes to default, you can press the reset button in the upper right corner. ### Observing Changes in Hip Shape Turn the view to the back to observe. Now let's see how the hip shape changes when adjusting each parameter. #### Waistline Adjustment The first parameter is the waistline. The waistline can adjust the natural waistline between the hip and thigh sides. Slide the slide to the left to reduce the waistline value. Note that when moving the slide for the first time, it may pop up a message window. If you choose not to display it, the next time you move the slide, the window will not appear. Press OK to confirm, then move the slide to the left. As the value decreases, you will see that the curve on both sides of the hip becomes more pronounced. Slide the slide to the right to increase the waistline, which can fill the volume on both sides of the hip and thus form a rounder hip shape. #### Size Adjustment Next, let's create a more flat or more curved hip by adjusting the second parameter, size. Let's turn to the side view to observe. You will see that there are two options at the bottom of the slide. If you slide the slide, you can create a more flat hip shape. Sliding to the right can increase the size of the upper part of the hip and improve the appearance of the hip. This function is also used in male virtual models. First, let's add a male virtual model in the MV2.1 version. You will find the hip in the same position. The type, O-line, and volume parameters are the same as female virtual models due to the same operation process. You can directly adjust the value and adjust the hip according to your needs. ### Important Notes on Adjustments Please note that adjusting these hip parameters will not affect the size, value, or measurement of the hip or lower hip. By using the new function in the virtual model editor, you can easily create various hip shapes. ## Customized Symmetry Configuration In the previous version, we had to use third-party software to name each pair of shoes or earrings correctly in order to define the shoes in the system. In the latest version, the customized symmetry configuration has become more convenient. ### Example: Configuring Shoes Next, we will use shoes as an example. First, open a virtual model. Then, click on the virtual model in the main menu bar and select the customized configuration. In the customized configuration, find the configuration type and select shoes. You can choose either flat shoes or high heels. Here, we will use high heels to demonstrate. Next, click on the file plus icon to insert the file containing two shoes at the same time. After this update, we also support files in the OBJ format. The system can automatically identify each shoe without needing to name it by left or right. ### Managing Shoe Settings In addition, in the new version, you can directly select two shoes. Right-click and select shoes. You will see that the shoes will be displayed in red. If you set it wrong, you can right-click again and select "cancel settings" as shoes. This step is only applicable to high heels because it needs to automatically raise the virtual model's heel to adapt when loading. ### Saving Shoe Configurations Next, we will save the shoes so that next time, you can directly use the saved configuration file. I hope these functions can help you optimize your workflow and make the process of customizing the matching configuration more convenient. ## New Workflow Enhancements Next, I will introduce you to the 2025.0 version, which includes another workflow that can greatly simplify the process. ### Flip Position Functionality Now you can see that the virtual model currently has a side position. In the previous version, if you wanted to do the mirror effect of the current position, you had to modify the position from the beginning. But in the new version, you only need to right-click on the virtual model and select the "flip position" option. This will immediately convert the virtual model into a flipped position, and the costume will also be simulated accordingly. This function allows you to try various positions and easily flip them, enabling more freedom to test the effect of different angles when simulated. ## Updates to Chest Size Editing In the new version, the virtual model editor also has another important update. You can create and edit the chest of the female virtual model to match the size of the cup. Let's see how to edit it. ### Editing Chest Size Open the virtual model editor. Under the virtual model size option card, in the width section, select the chest. Now you can set the detailed information. Activate the cup size option. After activating, you can set the standard size of the chest. You can change the number of sizes, with the smallest value being 3 and the largest value being 6. In addition, you can also change the name and value of each cup size. This value indicates the difference between the chest and the lower chest. If you want to reset it to default, you can click reset. ### Finalizing Chest Adjustments After setting up, you can exit the detailed information window. Now you can choose the cup size according to the previous size preset. Just click the down arrow to select the cup size you want to use. The chest cup size will be adjusted accordingly, and you will see the value you just set displayed at the bottom of the chest size. This function can help you create a more standard chest size and make the virtual model chest adjustment process more standardized. ### Conclusion Use the reset function first to ensure a clean slate, then proceed to make virtual model chest adjustments as usual. ```
